en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-38 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “

My daughter (the Blessed Lady) Fatima (a.s.) will be resurrected while sheis wearing the honored vest made from the water of life. The people will look at her and be surprised. Then they will see a thousand similar vests on which the following is written in green, ‘Take Muhammad’s daughter to Paradise in the best way, the most honor and with the best surrounding scenery.’ Then seventy-thousand maids will be charged with taking her to Paradise like a bride.”
